messages:
Priya G: Quick sync — running a brief tabletop tomorrow 09:00 UTC to validate the EU restore runbook and confirm backup verification cadence. Need owners for: DB snapshot consistency check, S3/objstore restore test, and multi-region routing TTL hunt.
Diego M: I can take DB snapshot consistency. Will run the compare job and share a script.
Riley S: I’ll own S3/objstore restore test. planning a dry-restore to a staging cluster and a smoke test.
Jenna K: I’ll do routing TTLs and BGP/ingress policy checks. want to validate failover path selection + weights.
Carlos P: tagging in infra: can help with ephemeral restore infra and perms for Riley. @OpsBot please create a temp role for the dry-restore.
OpsBot: Created temp-role restore-temp-eu-2026 with expiration 2026-04-10T00:00:00Z. Link: https://internal.redwood/iam/roles/restore-temp-eu-2026
Priya G: thanks. action logging: please add your action items to the tracker doc (link below) with owner, acceptance criteria, and due date. we want everything validated before the game-day on 2026-04-09. https://docs.internal/redwood/dr-tabletop/eu-restore-checklist
Diego M: ACTION: Diego M — run cross-region snapshot diff and confirm no ledger gaps. Acceptance: checksums match OR documented gap & recovery plan. Due: 2026-04-06 EOD. I’ll attach results in the tracker.
Riley S: ACTION: Riley S — dry-restore S3 objects to staging + run smoke queries. Acceptance: app-level reads succeed and top-5 queries return expected latencies. Due: 2026-04-05 midday.
Jenna K: ACTION: Jenna K — routing TTL hunt: enumerate route TTLs and failover trigger thresholds; produce playbook snippet for forced failover. Acceptance: runbook snippet + validation steps. Due: 2026-04-04.
Sam T: I'll QA the runbook steps and run one scripted run-through with Diego and Riley on 2026-04-07. Adding times to calendar.
Carlos P: note: recurring incident pattern — we've seen a cluster of ttl-related flaps in eu-west-1 the last 3 DR events. tag: routing/ingress. putting a short diag in the tracker.
Priya G: good call. can someone add a short postmortem mini-note listing the recurring symptom/lead indicators? that'll help Optimize team tune alerts.
Diego M: added summary: "repeated ingress reweight after control-plane lag -> delayed kvcache priming" with sample logs. I’ll paste the grep snippet here during runbook updates:
```
2026-03-21T01:12:14Z control-plane: weight-sync timeout for region eu-west-1: 23s
2026-03-21T01:12:14Z kvcache: priming failed for shard-3 (retry)
```
Riley S: small note — when we do dry-restore, watch eventual consistency window for object listings. I recommend running the restore with a 30s wait + re-list step.
Jenna K: for routing tests, use the following quick curl to validate egress path (example):
```
curl -H "Host: api.eu.redwood.test" https://canary-proxy.redwood.test/health -v
```
Check X-Region-Selected header.
Priya G: timeline recap in tracker: owners assigned, due dates set, tabletop 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC, rehearsal 2026-04-07 15:00 UTC. please flag any blockers by EOD today.
Sam T: blocker: I need a short-lived DB read user to run smoke queries. Carlos, can you expedite?
Carlos P: created db-read-temp user. creds posted to 1password with tag "incidents/eu-restore".
Priya G: nice. final ask — after you complete tasks, add a short "validation note" in tracker and drop the artifact (script/logs) link. we’ll compile for the postmortem follow-up. :thumbsup:
Diego M: will do.
Riley S: acked.
Jenna K: ack.
Sam T: ack.
OpsBot: Calendar event created: "EU Restore Tabletop — DR Game-day Prep" 2026-04-09 09:00 UTC. Invitees: Priya G, Diego M, Riley S, Jenna K, Carlos P, Sam T.
